newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures erase losses, close higher.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures erase losses, close higher.

text.p: Nov 8 - U.S. stock index futures rallied in the afternoon, reversing early losses to close sharply higher. December S&P 500 futures touched an all-time high of 734.50 in late trade, buoyed by apparent institutional buying. Traders expected some more follow-through buying next week but cautioned that the market could see significant correction soon.
